oneMinute.reasonExcluded: only about 91-100 sessions; shorter than 5-minute archive

iopv.reasonExcluded: not merged into mootdx OHLCV and only five days

adjustmentAudit.risk: Raw/unadjusted bars; detected overnight discontinuities are not crossed by any feature or label.

timezoneAudit.risk: timezone is inferred from TDX session convention

feasibleWindows.tradingTimeConvention: 48 ordered five-minute trading bars; lunch break compressed, never crosses overnight

skippedHorizons.60: A 60-bar horizon exceeds one 48-bar A-share session and remains null.

lppls.interpretation: The fixed grid supplies shape diagnostics only. tc is reported as a nested-window distribution and is not a point forecast.

koopman.interpretation: This is fixed-window linear delay-DMD. No kernel or deep Koopman operator is fitted.

multipleSelectionBias.note: No candidate receives production or forward credit from this historical screen.

phase2B.conclusion: No candidate passes the fixed historical gate at both 5 and 10 bars; Phase 2B is not justified.

mechanicalFrequencyCheck.scopeCaveat: All ablations use identical rows, but the DMD-complete common population excludes mainly earlier intraday windows and is not the full Phase 1 EWS population.
